validation_ack.reason: Capital increases during 2022 (5 Jan 2022 A5-DB/Singtel Alpha from the Rp1tn advance; 19 Jul 2022 Singtel Alpha and PT Kudo Teknologi Indonesia (Grab); 23 Dec 2022 PT Tiga Sira Sejahtera - FS2022 Note 15, PDF pp. 60-61) took the share count from 9,773,660,000 to 23,162,059,576, so basic EPS (8.5) uses weighted-average shares of 18,262,240,500 (IPO FS Note 33, PDF p. 113): -155,187 / 18,262.2m = -8.50. EPS x year-end shares overstates the loss by ~27%; the gap is real.

Shares rose from 23,162,059,576 to 26,408,717,026 in Jul-Sep 2023 (APIC conversion 11 Jul, 373.2m Series B incentive shares 28 Aug, 2.65bn KakaoBank shares 27 Sep 2023; FS2024 Note 19), so the FY2023 loss per share (15.8) uses weighted-average shares of 24,316,293,729 (IPO FS Note 33): -385,101 / 24,316.3m = -15.84. Real gap.

126.8m Series B shares (30 Apr 2024) and 2.80bn Series A shares (21 Jun 2024) were issued during the year (FS2024 Note 19), so the FY2024 loss per share (13.0) uses weighted-average shares of 28,144,006,254 (FS2025 Note 32): -366,367 / 28,144.0m = -13.02, while year-end shares are 29,340,405,350. Real gap (~4%).

IPO: 4,406,612,300 new shares issued 18 Dec 2025 (plus 150m Series B in Apr 2025), so FY2025 basic EPS (3.3) uses weighted-average shares of 29,827,679,271 (FS2025 Note 32, PDF p. 81): 99,684 / 29,827.7m = 3.34, while year-end shares are 33,897,017,650. Real gap (~12%).

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document came from Superbank's own channels and was fetched with plain curl (browser User-Agent) on 2026-11-03; no bot challenge was bypassed and no Internet Archive copy was needed for data. The www.superbank.id IR HTML pages return 403 to this server (intermittent WAF), but the site's public JSON endpoints https://api.superbank.id/api/v1/id/laporantahunans, .../laporankeuangantahunan and .../laporankeuangantriwulan (used by the IR pages; they also returned 403 on some tries) list the documents, which are stored in Superbank's own S3 bucket bucket-bfm-prd.s3.ap-southeast-3.amazonaws.com ('bfm' = Bank Fama). Those S3 URLs are the source_url values. Other files are on www.superbank.id/content/files/. idx.co.id was not used. The full IPO prospectus (/content/files/prospektus-superbank-penawaran-umum-perdana-saham.pdf) returned 403 on every try; the short prospectus (Prospektus Ringkas) and the audited IPO FS (30 Jun 2025, FY2024/23/22) were used instead. Note: the website terms (/syarat-ketentuan, 'Kekayaan Intelektual') prohibit systematic retrieval of site content into a database without Superbank's written permission; the figures here are from public regulatory filings, but the owner should be aware.

ENTITY HISTORY: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk is the former PT Bank Fama International (Bandung, founded 1993), a small private bank. Emtek (PT Elang Media Visitama + PT Nusantara Berkat Agung) bought 100% in Dec 2021; A5-DB Holdings and Singtel Alpha (Jan 2022), Grab (PT Kudo Teknologi Indonesia), KakaoBank (Sep 2023) and GXS Bank (Aug 2025, from Singtel) joined. Renamed Superbank in Feb 2023 (FS2023 title 'formerly PT Bank Fama International'); digital app launched Jun 2024. IPO 10-15 Dec 2025 at Rp635, 4,406,612,300 new shares (13%), net proceeds Rp2,730.8bn; listed 17 Dec 2025 (FS2025 Note 21). FY2020-FY2021 are a different, tiny conventional bank (assets Rp1.7-2.7tn), so growth and ROE comparisons across 2021-2023 reflect a rebuilt business, not organic growth.

BASIS: the Bank has no subsidiaries in any year (FY2019 published statement 'Bank tidak memiliki anak perusahaan'; all FS are 'Laporan Keuangan', not consolidated). Money fields are stored with basis 'consolidated' (the validator requires it for profit/equity); equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Ratios are 'bank_only' as printed in the OJK-format ratio tables (ARs / published reports).

LOSS YEARS (real data, not errors): net losses FY2021 -33.8bn, FY2022 -155.2bn, FY2023 -385.1bn, FY2024 -366.4bn; profit FY2020 12.1bn (Bank Fama) and FY2025 99.7bn (first full-year profit of the digital bank); 9M2026 profit 299.9bn. Accumulated deficit Rp846bn at 31 Dec 2025, Rp546bn at 30 Sep 2026.

RATIOS OUTSIDE THE VALIDATOR'S PLAUSIBLE RANGES ARE REAL: LDR 252.96 (FY2022) and 316.89 (FY2023) because deposits were tiny (Rp0.37tn / Rp0.92tn) before the app launch; CAR 174.31 (FY2021), 253.62 (FY2022), 185.63 (FY2023), 95.84 (FY2024), 93.24 (FY2025) because of repeated capital injections and the IPO; CIR 209.33 and BOPO 208.58/239.67 (FY2022-FY2023) because costs exceeded income; ROA -10.86 (FY2023). All are printed in the company's own ratio tables and are consistent with the FS levels.

RATIO SOURCE CHOICES / CONFLICTS: FY2020 ratios from AR2020's own table (= FY2020 published statement). FY2021 ratios from the audited FY2021 OJK published statement (= AR2022 and AR2023 reprints); AR2021's own ratio table prints different ROE/ROA (-1.72/-1.24 vs -3.08/-2.47) and is not used. FY2020 NPL net 4.32 (own-year documents) vs 4.42 in the FY2021 statement/AR2021 (looks like the 2019 value carried over). FY2023 NPL coverage: prospectus summary 251.14 vs AR2025 238.8 - the prospectus value matches the audited FS2023 and is used. FY2025 ratios use the 2-decimal OJK published report of 31 Dec 2025; AR2025 prints the same values rounded to 1 decimal.

SHARES / PER-SHARE: EPS was not presented while Bank Fama was private (FY2020-FY2021: null). FY2022-FY2024 loss per share first appears in the IPO FS (reissued 12 Nov 2025) and FY2024 again in FS2025. All EPS use weighted-average shares; years with capital increases (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) therefore fail EPS x year-end shares - acknowledged in validation_ack with the weighted counts. shares_out FY2023/FY2024 include the Series B employee incentive shares (Rp1 nominal, no voting rights, held by Bersama Sustainability Trust: 373,204,000 / 500,000,000) because the EPS denominators include them; Series A alone: 26,035,513,026 / 28,840,405,350. FY2020 shares_out is null because AR2020 (7,805m shares incl. a Rp365bn 30-Dec-2020 capital increase) conflicts with the audited balance sheet (that Rp365bn is 'advance for capital'). year_end_price exists only for FY2025 (935, 30 Dec 2025).

CORPORATE ACTIONS: none recorded. Since listing (17 Dec 2025) there has been no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue: the share count is 33,897,017,650 at 31 Dec 2025 and 30 Sep 2026 (interim FS), and the IR 'Aksi Korporasi' page lists only the IPO documents. Pre-IPO capital changes, all while the company was private (no market, no ex-date, no effect on any stored per-share value): (a) in 2020 the nominal value went from Rp100 million to Rp100 per share (AR2020/AR2021 profile; 1:1,000,000) alongside capital increases; (b) many private placements 2020-2025 (2 Oct 2020 Rp350bn, 30 Dec 2020 Rp365bn, 23 Aug 2021 Rp196.9bn, Jan 2022 Rp1tn, 2022 Grab/others, 2023 KakaoBank, Jun 2024 Rp1.26tn, employee Series B shares 2023-2025); (c) 11 Nov 2025 the FS call a 'penggabungan saham (reverse stock split) atas seluruh saham seri B': the 650,000,000 Series B shares (Rp1) became 650,000,000 shares of Rp100 by capitalising Rp64.35bn of share premium - the share COUNT did not change (Prospektus Ringkas p. 1 capital table; FS2025 Note 21), so the factor is 1. If the owner wants (a) or (c) in corporate_actions.json, note they predate the first price row.

DIVIDENDS: no dividend since the 2021 takeover (AR2025 p. 77; AGMS 27 Apr 2026 decided no dividend for FY2025 because of the deficit; IR page 'Perseroan belum memiliki riwayat Informasi Dividen'). The only dividend in the window is the Rp196.9bn 'interim dividend' the private Bank Fama paid its founding families on 23 Aug 2021 (recorded under fy 2021, total only, no DPS/dates). Dividend policy from the prospectus: up to 85% of net profit once retained earnings are positive, first planned out of FY2029 profit.

INTERIM: 9M2026 from the unaudited interim FS (authorised 28 Oct 2026) for money items and shares, and the OJK published report of the same date for ratios. The prior-year balances (30 Sep 2025) come from the 30 Sep 2025 published report because no 9M2025 FS is posted; deposits_prior is the sum of the printed Giro/Tabungan/Deposito lines (no DPK total in that format). CoC, NPL coverage and CASA are not disclosed (null).

NULLS (main reasons): CoC, CASA every year (never disclosed as ratios); LaR FY2020-FY2025 (industry figures only); NPL coverage FY2020-FY2021; CIR FY2020-FY2021; EPS FY2020-FY2021 (not presented while private); year_end_price FY2020-FY2024 (not listed); shares_out FY2020 (conflicting sources); payout FY2020/FY2021 (see notes).

DATES: FS authorised for issue - FY2022 29 Mar 2023, FY2023 28 Mar 2024, FY2024 17 Mar 2025, IPO FS reissued 12 Nov 2025, FY2025 9 Mar 2026, 9M2026 28 Oct 2026. FY2021 published statement dated 25 Apr 2022.
